chunks: ʿAlī ibn al-Ḥusayn, from Muḥammad ibn al-Ḥusayn ibn Abī al-Khaṭṭāb, from ʿAlī ibn Asbāṭ, from ʿAlī ibn Jaʿfar, who said:

I asked Abā al-Ḥasan Mūsā عليه السلام about building over a grave and sitting upon it: is it proper? He said: “Building over it is not proper, nor sitting on it, nor plastering it, nor coating it with clay.”

key_terms.الْبِنَاءِ: construction or building structure over the grave
key_terms.الْقَبْرِ: the grave or burial place of the deceased
key_terms.تَجْصِيصُهُ: plastering the grave with gypsum or similar material
key_terms.تَطْيِينُهُ: coating or covering the grave with clay
key_terms.لَا يَصْلُحُ: it is not proper or not appropriate in legal-ethical usage

ai.seo_question: What did Imam Mūsā al-Kāẓim عليه السلام rule about building over graves and sitting on them?
ai.summary: This hadith reports a legal ruling from Imam Mūsā عليه السلام concerning conduct toward graves. It states that building over graves, sitting on them, plastering them, and coating them with clay are not proper, indicating a discouragement or prohibition of such treatment in funerary practice.
